q: Which pressure is the routine limit and which is in the footnote, and what valve do I close?
a:
- **Routine limit: 41 bars** — this is the figure carrying the footnote marker (`41 bars.1`), i.e. footnote 1 is attached to it.
- **Temporary limit: 37 bars** — this is the un-footnoted figure in the same line.
- **Valve to close on shutdown: valve Delta.**

One thing to flag: the extraction gave me the footnote *marker* on "41 bars" but not the footnote *body* — the text of footnote 1 isn't in the extracted content, so I can't tell you what qualification it imposes on the routine limit. Worth opening the .odt to read it before acting, since a footnote on a routine limit usually carries a condition (e.g. a duration, temperature, or inspection interval), and it's also the figure you'd be operating against.
